strategy.name: Top-Down Big Tech Trend (Free Tier)
strategy.approach: Daily chart sets the directional bias using two EMAs. 15-minute chart times the entry using VWAP. Only take entries on the 15m that agree with the daily bias.
primary_timeframes: 15 (entry timing — US market hours only, 14:30-21:00 UK)
strategy.note: Trimmed to fit TradingView Free tier (2 indicators per chart). Removed RSI and ATR; using flat 2% stop instead.

daily.ema_20: Short-term trend on the daily. Price above it = short-term strength.
daily.ema_50: Medium-term trend. 20 EMA above 50 EMA = confirmed uptrend.

intraday_15m.ema_9: Fast intraday trend. Turning up = short-term momentum returning.
intraday_15m.vwap: Volume Weighted Average Price - the average price paid today. Price above VWAP = buyers winning the session.

bullish: Daily: price is above both the 20 EMA and the 50 EMA
Daily: 20 EMA is above the 50 EMA
bearish: Daily: price is below both the 20 EMA and the 50 EMA
Daily: 20 EMA is below the 50 EMA
neutral: Daily: price is chopping between the 20 EMA and the 50 EMA
Daily: the 20 EMA and 50 EMA are flat or tangled together

long: Daily bias must be bullish (price and 20 EMA both above 50 EMA)
15m: the 9 EMA is sloping up and price is holding above it
short: Daily bias must be bearish (price and 20 EMA both below 50 EMA)
15m: the 9 EMA is sloping down and price is holding below it

exit_rules: Exit a long when the daily 20 EMA crosses back below the daily 50 EMA
Exit a short when the daily 20 EMA crosses back above the daily 50 EMA
Stop loss: 2% below entry for longs, 2% above entry for shorts (flat stop, adapted for free tier)
risk_rules: Risk 1% of the account on any single trade
Position size = (1% of account) divided by (2%) — so each trade risks exactly 1% if you hit the stop
Only take trades where the reward-to-risk is at least 1:2
Maximum 3 open positions at once across the watchlist
No new entries in the first 15 minutes of the US open (14:30-14:45 UK) - too erratic
Earnings: no new entries in the 2 days before a scheduled earnings report
notes: Top-down strategy across five big tech names, trimmed to fit TradingView Free tier (2 indicators per chart). The daily chart is the boss - if the daily bias is not clearly bullish or bearish, there is no trade regardless of what the 15m is doing. Intraday entries only matter during US market hours (14:30-21:00 UK time); outside those hours the morning brief is a daily-bias read only. This file is advisory: it tells me what my own rules say, it does not place trades.
